    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Board
    Interface representing the game board for Tetris.
    BoardRenderer
    Renders the main game board, including the background grid, current piece, and ghost piece (preview of where the piece will land).
    Brick
    Interface representing a Tetris brick (tetromino).
    BrickGenerator
    Interface for generating Tetris bricks.
    BrickRotator
    Manage the rotation state of the current Tetris brick.
    ClearRow
    Result of clearing completed rows from the game board.
    ColorUtil
    Utility class for mapping brick type IDs to their corresponding colors.
    DownData
    Downward move operation.
    EventSource
    Source of game event.
    EventType
    Type of movement event in the game.
    GameController
    Main game controller that coordinates between the game logic (Board) and the UI (GuiController).
    GameListener
    Interface for objects that listen to game state changes.
    GameOverPanel
    A panel that displays the "GAME OVER" message when the player loses.
    GarbageRow
    Manages the periodic addition of garbage rows to the game board.
    GarbageRow.GarbageCallback
     
    GuiController
    Main GUI controller for the Tetris game.
    HoldRenderer
    Renders the held Tetris piece that the player can swap with the current piece.
    InputEventListener
    Interface for handling input events from the user or game thread.
    InputHandler
    Handles keyboard input for the game.
    Main
    Main entry point for the Tetris game application.
    MatrixOperations
    Utility class providing static methods for matrix operations used in Tetris.
    MoveEvent
    Represents a movement event in the game, containing both the event type (direction/rotation) and the source (user input or automatic).
    NextShapeInfo
    Contains information about the next rotation state of a brick.
    NotificationPanel
    A panel that displays temporary notifications with animation.
    PreviewRenderer
    Renders the preview of the next five Tetris pieces that will appear.
    RandomBrickGenerator
    Generates Tetris bricks using a completely random selection algorithm.
    Score
    Manages the game score and level progression.
    SevenBagGenerator
    Generates Tetris bricks using the "7-bag" algorithm.
    SimpleBoard
    Implementation of the Board interface representing the main game board.
    Sound
    Manages sound effects and background music for the game.
    ViewData
    Immutable data class to render the game view.
